deploy-bot: deploy finished for service=inference-proxy version=2026.03.21-rc3
Alex K: saw the bot — is postdeploy smoke run ok? pinging @sre-oncall
sre-oncall: running quick synthetic probes now (eu/us regions). will post results in ~2m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maria S: tagging for pin decision — if any region p95 > 600ms we should consider pin to previous stable.
deploy-bot: smoke-results: eu: p50=120ms p95=560ms errors=0; us: p50=110ms p95=450ms errors=1 (429s). full report: https://internal/reports/174212
Sam T: noticing occasional 429s from edge-gateway in us-west-2, correlates with an autoscaler spin-up. collecting logs.
Joanne: propose we keep rollout but hold new traffic for mobile clients until another sweep. mobile traffic is 25% of RU — agree?
Lee: +1 to hold mobiles. If errors persist after one more synthetic run, we rollback. Threshold: sustained p95>600 for 3 consecutive samples.
sre-oncall: reran with --sample=200 --route=mobile. results: mobile p95=610ms, errors=2 (timeout). attaching quick log snippet:
```
[2026-03-21T15:22:10Z] route=mobile req_id=abc123 duration=610ms status=504
[2026-03-21T15:22:12Z] route=mobile req_id=abc124 duration=620ms status=504
```
Alex K: ok that crosses threshold. Maria? should we pin to v2026.03.08-stable for mobile route only?
Maria S: yes. open A/B pin request in console, target mobile route, sticky to v2026.03.08-stable. include reason and smoke logs.
Joanne: I'll run a targeted canary revert for mobile routing and monitor for 10m. starting now.
deploy-bot: started route-pin action id=pin_1742123456 by=Joanne target=v2026.03.08-stable scope=route:mobile
sre-oncall: once pin applied, I'll re-run the synthetic probe and post updated metrics.
(10m later)
sre-oncall: post-pin synthetic: mobile p95=220ms errors=0; overall p95 improved. mobile traffic back to normal. recommend leave pin for 1h while we investigate root cause.
Alex K: thanks — will create a follow-up ticket to debug autoscaler synergy with tokenizer warmup. assign to infra-team and eng-runtime.
Sam T: fyi I pulled kernel traces, sending to infra now.
Maria S: leaving pin for 1h sounds good. schedule a rollback if regression returns. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: thread closed by deploy-bot (note: pin active until 2026-03-21T17:30:00Z unless manually removed)
